description: The pie chart presents the domain distribution of the annotated AttrEval‑GenSearch test set and contains 12 slices, each labeled with a domain name and percentage, with leader lines connecting labels placed around the chart (no separate legend is shown). The slices and approximate shares are: AI/NLP Research (blue) at 24.3%, Econ. & Fin. (teal/cyan) at 18.4%, History (yellow) at 8.2%, Game&Anime (orange) at 8.2%, Daily Life (light cyan) at 7.1%, Med & Health (green) at 6.7%, Science (light blue) at 6.7%, Business (red) at 5.9%, Pet & Animal (light orange) at 5.5%, Law (pink/salmon) at 5.1%, Geography (yellow/gold) at 2.7%, and Math (dark green) at 1.2%. Percentages are displayed next to the labels rather than inside the slices, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the segments do not appear arranged in a strictly descending order by size.
